name: Vanderbilt intraoperative THA fluoroscopy (Chan et al., J Arthroplasty 2025)
what: 146 living patients, 161 anterior-approach hips, 336 AP frames with eight bony landmarks including midline L5/S1 and both sacroiliac joints, plus 84 cup frames; AP only; the C-arm is not reported; no data statement, code only at github.com/vine-lab-vu/Label-Augmentation (doi:10.1016/j.arth.2025.01.032)
level_truth: midline L5/S1 and both sacroiliac joints marked by an expert; no vertebra above named
licence: not recorded; a data use agreement with Vanderbilt is the route
how_to_get: Write to the corresponding author named on the paper (Vanderbilt Orthopaedic Surgery and Computer Science); the letter is letters/vanderbilt_tha_fluoro.md.
A yes brings a data use agreement with Vanderbilt, which the owner signs, then a transfer by link, fetched as a grid job on the owner's word.
record: SchwingNet docs/research/xray-dataset-requests.md section 15 (2026-10-21); no record under SchwingNet's data/sources/ existed for this set, so this one was written from that section
source_status: a letter sent 2026-10-21; no record in SchwingNet's registry yet
